# Regression coverage matrix

<!-- Generated by `python -m e2e coverage --write` from tests/config/scope.yaml and the scenario `covers` keys. Do not edit by hand. -->

Source: [#140](https://github.com/openhab/openhab-garmin/issues/140).

## Summary

| Measure | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Scope entries | 65 |
| Covered by at least one scenario | 36 |
| Waived with a reason | 27 |
| Blocked by a tracked issue | 2 |
| Empty (must be 0) | 0 |
| Scenario files | 33 |
| Expanded scenario runs | 83 |
| Language variants blocked (no measured index) | 0 |

> **Host-only execution.** Every scenario listed below needs a Linux host
> with Docker, the Connect IQ SDK and the simulator. The `harness` CI job
> validates the scenario schema, the dry run and this mapping; it never
> executes a scenario. Nothing in this table has been run against the stack
> yet, and a waiver is a deliberate gap rather than a passing test.
>
> **The glance is excluded from E2E builds.** The app crashes the simulator
> on its first glance draw (`Invalid Font Specified` in
> `GlanceSitemapView.onUpdate`), so every scenario builds with the
> `without-glance` profile: the glance view is replaced by an empty stub and
> draws nothing. Glance-related entries are **blocked**, not waived, and no
> green run is glance coverage. Re-enable it with
> `python -m e2e run --with-glance` (or `e2e build --with-glance`) once
> [#396](https://github.com/openhab/openhab-garmin/issues/396) is resolved;
> see [simulator-driver.md](simulator-driver.md#glance-the-profile-that-keeps-runs-alive).
>
> **Language provisioning is blocked.** The simulator's device language is
> set from its own UI; the harness cannot apply it (`Language` in
> `simulator.ini` is written and preserved but ignored, and `LANG`,
> `LANGUAGE` and `LC_ALL` make no difference). A matrix therefore runs in
> the simulator's default language only, and its other languages are listed
> as **blocked**, not as evidence. See
> [simulator-driver.md](simulator-driver.md#language-cannot-be-provisioned).

A scenario may exercise part of an entry and mark the rest in
`manual_checks`; those checks are listed in the last column and are not
machine-asserted.

## 5. App lifecycle and device integration

| Scope id | Title | Status | Scenarios or waiver | Manual checks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lifecycle.cold-start` | Cold start into the sitemap, loading, cached sitemap and startup error view | Covered | `extended/localisation-error-config-url-round` (ui, fenix7, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`smoke/launch-and-poll` (ui, fenix7) | `extended/localisation-error-config-url-round`: The ERRORVIEW id and the error view being the current view are machine-asserted; the wrapped or truncated rendered text is review-only.<br>`smoke/launch-and-poll`: Selection, Setpoint and Slider elements are present in the fixture but are not driven by this scenario. |
| `lifecycle.deferred-errors` | Error while hidden or before a view exists, presented when the app becomes visible | Waived | Waived: Hiding the app and resuming it needs a device sleep or app-switcher action the driver cannot issue; errors.deferred has the same gap. | — |
| `lifecycle.stop-start` | App stop and start, termination after inactivity and device sleep events | Waived | Waived: A scenario has exactly one launch step, so stop/start and termination after inactivity cannot be expressed in one scenario. | — |
| `lifecycle.glance-widget` | Glance and widget content and refresh, including states only available in BLE mode | Blocked | **Blocked:** The app crashes the simulator on its first glance draw (`Invalid Font Specified` in `GlanceSitemapView.onUpdate`), before any HTTP request, and the glance latch is the deeper cause: `getGlanceView()` sets `AppLifecycle.setGlance()`, and in the simulator's single process that flag makes every lifecycle guard bail out, so `getInitialView()` never runs. E2E builds use the `watch-app` profile (generated manifest, stubbed glance view), which is the right app type but cannot undo the latch. Widget and glance content therefore cannot be inspected or asserted. Re-enable the real glance with `--with-glance` once #396 is resolved. ([#396](https://github.com/openhab/openhab-garmin/issues/396)) | — |
| `lifecycle.connection-return` | Behaviour after the phone or network returns | Waived | Waived: Returning to the phone or network is a mid-run mode transition, which the driver cannot drive (see communication.transitions). | — |
| `lifecycle.device-matrix-and-strings` | Supported-device matrix coverage and localized user-facing strings | Covered | `extended/localisation-sitemap` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable)) | `extended/localisation-sitemap`: Rendered text is reviewed in screenshots; the harness has no OCR or text assertion. This covers the screens the scenario visits, not a string-by-string inventory, and glance/widget strings are not visited. |

the wrapped or truncated rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-config-url-round`: The ERRORVIEW id and the error view being the current view are machine-asserted; the wrapped or truncated rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-long-value`: The error view being the current view is machine-asserted; the long dynamic value wrapping is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-memory-class`: The literal ErrorOutOfMemory text is not triggered; the -402 path renders in the same ErrorView, and the rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-multiline`: The error view being the current view is machine-asserted; the multi-line rendered detail depends on the SDK error and is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-glyphs`: Glyph rendering is review-only: there is no OCR or region-hash assertion, so the captured PNGs must be inspected for missing glyphs and fallback boxes.<br>`extended/localisation-settings-menu`: Rendered text is reviewed in screenshots; the harness has no OCR or text assertion.<br>`extended/localisation-settings-menu`: The Wi-Fi update action gating is not exercised by this scenario.<br>`extended/localisation-sitemap`: Rendered text is reviewed in screenshots; the harness has no OCR or text assertion. This covers the screens the scenario visits, not a string-by-string inventory, and glance/widget strings are not visited.<br>`extended/localisation-toast-empty-page`: The toast text is reviewed in screenshots; the harness asserts that a toast appeared, not what it says.<br>`extended/localisation-toast-offline-command`: The toast text is reviewed in screenshots; the harness asserts that a toast appeared and that no command was sent, not what the toast says. |

## 7. Error handling - temporary, critical and fatal

| Scope id | Title | Status | Scenarios or waiver | Manual checks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `errors.temporary` | Temporary errors (command, polling, user input, suppressed empty responses) | Covered | `extended/connection-reset` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/command-error-temporary` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/empty-response` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/http-503-recovery` (protocol, fenix7) | `regression/empty-response`: The suppressed-empty variant (the `suppress-empty` fixture) and the cached-versus-uncached escalation distinction are not exercised here.<br>`regression/http-503-recovery`: This proves a three-poll sitemap outage stays temporary; it does not prove loss and recovery of the phone, Wi-Fi or the local network. |
| `errors.critical` | Critical errors (-1001, 404, -402, -403, parse and unexpected data) keep polling and recover | Covered | `extended/escalation-window` (ui, fenix7)<br>`extended/limits-over-limit` (ui, fenix7)<br>`extended/localisation-error-long-value` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/localisation-error-memory-class` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/localisation-error-multiline` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/oversized-response` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/malformed-json` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/escalation-window`: The documented "more than 10 seconds" boundary is not measured; the scenario proves only that a persistent failure reaches critical after the initial temporary phase.<br>`extended/limits-over-limit`: The exact byte size is checked by the fixture guard and documented in tests/docs/fixture-limits.md; the screenshot is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-long-value`: The error view being the current view is machine-asserted; the long dynamic value wrapping is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-memory-class`: The literal ErrorOutOfMemory text is not triggered; the -402 path renders in the same ErrorView, and the rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-multiline`: The error view being the current view is machine-asserted; the multi-line rendered detail depends on the SDK error and is review-only.<br>`extended/oversized-response`: This scenario deliberately serves 2 MiB, above both the simulator and the device limit. The measured 16 KiB simulator boundary is covered by `extended/limits-near-limit` and `extended/limits-over-limit`; see tests/docs/fixture-limits.md.<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery`: The -1001 and -403 critical paths are not exercised, and neither are the NO PHONE, INVRES and UNRES messages.<br>`regression/malformed-json`: No trace event distinguishes a cached sitemap from a fresh one, so cache invalidation before the error repeats is not asserted. |
| `errors.fatal` | Fatal errors show full-screen, latch polling off and cancel in-flight requests | Waived | Waived: A fatal UI error cannot be triggered through the shim, and the settings change path needs settings mutation after launch (settings.change-while-running). | — |
| `errors.escalation` | A temporary polling error escalates to critical after more than 10 seconds | Covered | `extended/escalation-window` (ui, fenix7) | `extended/escalation-window`: The documented "more than 10 seconds" boundary is not measured; the scenario proves only that a persistent failure reaches critical after the initial temporary phase. |
| `errors.no-escalation` | No escalation for command errors, suppressed empty responses, and cached versus uncached sitemaps | Covered | `regression/command-error-temporary` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/empty-response` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/http-503-recovery` (protocol, fenix7) | `regression/empty-response`: The suppressed-empty variant (the `suppress-empty` fixture) and the cached-versus-uncached escalation distinction are not exercised here.<br>`regression/http-503-recovery`: This proves a three-poll sitemap outage stays temporary; it does not prove loss and recovery of the phone, Wi-Fi or the local network. |
| `errors.recovery` | Critical recovers to normal; fatal recovers only through a restart and never self-recovers | Covered | `extended/escalation-window` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/http-503-recovery` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/malformed-json` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/escalation-window`: The documented "more than 10 seconds" boundary is not measured; the scenario proves only that a persistent failure reaches critical after the initial temporary phase.<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery`: The -1001 and -403 critical paths are not exercised, and neither are the NO PHONE, INVRES and UNRES messages.<br>`regression/http-503-recovery`: This proves a three-poll sitemap outage stays temporary; it does not prove loss and recovery of the phone, Wi-Fi or the local network.<br>`regression/malformed-json`: No trace event distinguishes a cached sitemap from a fresh one, so cache invalidation before the error repeats is not asserted. |
| `errors.deferred` | Deferred errors before a view exists, while hidden, and presentation on resume | Waived | Waived: Deferred error presentation needs the app hidden before the error occurs; see lifecycle.deferred-errors for the driver limitation. | — |
| `errors.cache-invalidation` | No stale sitemap is shown before a critical or fatal error repeats | Waived | Waived: No trace event distinguishes a cached sitemap from a fresh one, so "no stale sitemap" is only observable in pixels; no golden covers the critical or fatal path yet. | — |
| `errors.codes-messages` | User-facing codes and messages (S:/C: prefixes, NO PHONE, INVRES, EMRES, UNRES and UI: codes) | Covered | `extended/localisation-error-config-url` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/localisation-error-config-url-round` (ui, fenix7, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/oversized-response` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/command-error-temporary` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery` (ui, fenix7)<br>`regression/empty-response` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/malformed-json` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/localisation-error-config-url`: The ERRORVIEW id and the error view being the current view are machine-asserted; the wrapped or truncated rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-config-url-round`: The ERRORVIEW id and the error view being the current view are machine-asserted; the wrapped or truncated rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/oversized-response`: This scenario deliberately serves 2 MiB, above both the simulator and the device limit. The measured 16 KiB simulator boundary is covered by `extended/limits-near-limit` and `extended/limits-over-limit`; see tests/docs/fixture-limits.md.<br>`regression/critical-error-recovery`: The -1001 and -403 critical paths are not exercised, and neither are the NO PHONE, INVRES and UNRES messages.<br>`regression/empty-response`: The suppressed-empty variant (the `suppress-empty` fixture) and the cached-versus-uncached escalation distinction are not exercised here.<br>`regression/malformed-json`: No trace event distinguishes a cached sitemap from a fresh one, so cache invalidation before the error repeats is not asserted. |

| `limits.small-sitemaps` | Small sitemaps | Covered | `smoke/launch-and-poll` (ui, fenix7) | `smoke/launch-and-poll`: Selection, Setpoint and Slider elements are present in the fixture but are not driven by this scenario. |

| `limits.size-limit` | Approach, hit and exceed the response size limit (-402), including the simulator's lower JSON limit | Covered | `extended/limits-near-limit` (ui, fenix7)<br>`extended/limits-over-limit` (ui, fenix7)<br>`extended/localisation-error-memory-class` (ui, edge540, 6 languages (eng, deu, fre, ita, spa, pol runnable))<br>`extended/oversized-response` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/limits-near-limit`: The scenario proves the near-limit payload renders. The exact byte size is checked by the fixture guard and documented in tests/docs/fixture-limits.md; the screenshot is review-only.<br>`extended/limits-over-limit`: The exact byte size is checked by the fixture guard and documented in tests/docs/fixture-limits.md; the screenshot is review-only.<br>`extended/localisation-error-memory-class`: The literal ErrorOutOfMemory text is not triggered; the -402 path renders in the same ErrorView, and the rendered text is review-only.<br>`extended/oversized-response`: This scenario deliberately serves 2 MiB, above both the simulator and the device limit. The measured 16 KiB simulator boundary is covered by `extended/limits-near-limit` and `extended/limits-over-limit`; see tests/docs/fixture-limits.md. |
| `limits.large-data` | Large item counts, deep nesting, many icons and many updates per poll | Waived | Waived: The repository fixtures are intentionally small; a large, deeply nested sitemap fixture does not exist and adding one is a fixture-design decision for #140, not a scenario-level addition. | — |
| `limits.slow-and-rapid` | Slow or latent responses and rapid successive updates | Covered | `extended/slow-response` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/slow-response`: "Applied without an error view" is machine-asserted as a SITEMAP success event plus never_error_view. The exact latency bound, and whether a response slower than the transport timeout would still be applied, are not measured.<br>`extended/slow-response`: Rapid successive updates are not exercised; only delayed responses are. |
| `limits.storage-memory` | Stored data near the storage limits and low memory (-403) | Waived | Waived: Reaching the device storage or memory limits (-403) needs a low-memory device or a way to exhaust storage; neither is scriptable through the shim. | — |

## 9. Restart, outage and resilience

| Scope id | Title | Status | Scenarios or waiver | Manual checks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resilience.openhab-restart` | Restart of openHAB while the app runs, in each mode and state | Covered | `extended/openhab-restart` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/openhab-restart`: The openHAB container is not restarted by the scenario. With the stack up, run `docker compose -f tests/compose/compose.yaml restart openhab-stable` during this scenario (or repeat it by hand) to prove a real restart rather than the modelled outage window.<br>`extended/openhab-restart`: A restart that returns with a changed sitemap (removed items or changed structure) is not exercised; only an unchanged sitemap is.<br>`extended/openhab-restart`: Restart while the app is in Wi-Fi or offline mode, during startup, or while a command is in flight is not exercised. |
| `resilience.downtime` | Short and long openHAB downtime returning with an unchanged or a changed sitemap | Covered | `extended/openhab-restart` (protocol, fenix7) | `extended/openhab-restart`: The openHAB container is not restarted by the scenario. With the stack up, run `docker compose -f tests/compose/compose.yaml restart openhab-stable` during this scenario (or repeat it by hand) to prove a real restart rather than the modelled outage window.<br>`extended/openhab-restart`: A restart that returns with a changed sitemap (removed items or changed structure) is not exercised; only an unchanged sitemap is.<br>`extended/openhab-restart`: Restart while the app is in Wi-Fi or offline mode, during startup, or while a command is in flight is not exercised. |
| `resilience.connection-loss` | Loss and recovery of the phone (BLE), Wi-Fi and the local network | Covered | `extended/connection-reset` (protocol, fenix7)<br>`regression/http-503-recovery` (protocol, fenix7) | `regression/http-503-recovery`: This proves a three-poll sitemap outage stays temporary; it does not prove loss and recovery of the phone, Wi-Fi or the local network. |
| `resilience.soak` | Repeated restarts, soak testing and polling stability with interval 0 | Waived | Waived: Repeated restarts and a soak run do not fit the per-scenario budget and belong to a scheduled campaign, not to the pull-request suite; polling interval 0 is not exercised by a scenario either. | — |
